motions.item_title: Exploring the Potential for Five Plus (5+) Units in Guelph, 2025-567
motions.name: Main Motion
motions.text: That Council directs staff to continue evaluating the feasibility of permitting five or more residential units on low density residential lots (RL.1 and RL.2), and to undertake the following actions: Refine the criteria used to assess suitability for increased residential density; Prepare draft Official Plan policies and zoning by-law amendments, as necessary, to support the implementation of five or more residential units per lot; and Report back to Council in Q4 2026 with findings, proposed policy directions, and recommended regulatory changes for consideration.
motions.text_html:
1. That Council directs staff to continue evaluating the feasibility of permitting five or more residential units on low density residential lots (RL.1 and RL.2), and to undertake the following actions:
    1. Refine the criteria used to assess suitability for increased residential density;
    2. Prepare draft Official Plan policies and zoning by-law amendments, as necessary, to support the implementation of five or more residential units per lot; and
    3. Report back to Council in Q4 2026 with findings, proposed policy directions, and recommended regulatory changes for consideration.

motions.item_title: Exploring the Potential for Five Plus (5+) Units in Guelph, 2025-567
motions.name: First Amendment to Main Motion
motions.text: That clause 1 (a) of the main motion be amended to: Refine the criteria used to assess suitability for increased residential density that would only apply to corner lots that are adjacent to arterial and/or collector roads.

That clause 1 (a) of the main motion be amended to:
